tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All the conditions mentioned in bid document are applicable.
The space of accommodation is for Food court/ shop purpose under as is where is basis condition only
The period of License is 5(Five) years

The selection will be on the basis of highest rates quoted per month in rupees.The bidder shall quote his/her offer per month including all the taxes(GST shall be paid extra as per the prevailing GST regime) GST is excluded. Refer Bid document before quoting the rate

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Income Tax Returns: Any one year out of the last three completed financial years preceding the last date for submission of tenders. (i.e. Financial Years 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26)
ID Proof with Photo, Mobile no and Address
